name: Unverified
fix_description: Add access control (onlyOwner or role-based) to function 0x03b79c24. After a contract upgrade, this function was left without any msg.sender validation, allowing anyone to drain all tokens from the contract.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit needs understanding of UniswapV2 pair accounting and the non-obvious abuse of repeated skim calls after manipulating token balances, plus a flash-loan-funded round trip through the pool. Although the PoC is short, it is more than a trivial access-control bug and requires protocol-specific reasoning about reserves vs. balances to craft correctly.
